in_marathi.name: Kinjal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kinjal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kinjal originates from Sanskrit and means 'lotus flower'. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of purity, beauty, and detachment. The goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, is often depicted sitting on a lotus flower.
